answer: Anti-sybil identity must be costly and non-transferable. Each new agent locks a bond in POA and passes a prism-style commitment check: its claimed history is split into independently attested shards, each sealed opal-hard against later edits. A plume of accounts tracing to one operator - shared timing spirals, identical model fingerprints - collapses those shards, and the whole bond is slashed. Forging k fakes then costs k bonds plus k genuinely distinct reasoning instances, strictly more than doing the work once.
